claim: The original period T extends to a homeomorphism from the actual simultaneous compact Gamma1(3) cusp filling to independent standard OnePoint C, with exact original restriction and actual infinity/zero cusp values.

obligations.name: Independent target and actual source
obligations.required_input: Independently given actual source and target topologies.
obligations.constructed_input: Existing actual simultaneous filling and standard OnePoint complex topology.
obligations.justification: The source is precisely the existing TwoChartGluing318.Space of the original full Gamma1(3) orbit quotient and the finite family of actual cusp discs. Its topology and compactness are those already proved for that gluing. The target is Mathlib OnePoint C with its standard one-point compactification topology. Neither topology is defined by transporting the desired equivalence. This target is not yet identified with the analytification of the arithmetic projective-line scheme.

obligations.name: Selected representatives and coverage
obligations.required_input: All actual finite-end indices and their selected representatives.
obligations.constructed_input: End exhaustion, exact representative regions, periods and width transfer.
obligations.justification: The original finite End 3 object has exactly infinityEnd and zeroEnd. Its chosen integral representatives need not literally be the identity and S matrices. Their actual neighborhoods equal the defining end regions by representative_region. Equality of neighborhoods gives equality of the actual translation-period groups and hence their actual widths, supplying width one and width three for those selected charts.

obligations.name: Actual selected cusp orders
obligations.required_input: Orders of the actual selected source q germs.
obligations.constructed_input: Simple pole at selected infinity and simple zero at selected zero end.
obligations.justification: The exact q-germ order dichotomy applies to every rotation, so width one forces a simple pole at the selected infinity representative. At the selected zero representative, the alternative pole of order three is excluded using the actual inverse of the identity-cusp reciprocal parameter and global T injectivity. Its neighborhood is the original S region, disjoint from the original identity region. Thus the actual selected zero chart has order one. No arbitrary replacement of the selected q coordinates or end indices is made.

obligations.name: Full disc maps and boundary continuity
obligations.required_input: Continuity on full actual discs including origins.
obligations.constructed_input: Meromorphic order limits and standard one-point topology; analytic off zero.
obligations.justification: sphereChart c is the original qParameter at every nonzero q and the proved endpoint value at q=0. The meromorphic pole at infinity gives convergence to the cobounded filter on C; properness of C identifies it with the compact-complement filter used by the standard OnePoint topology. The positive-order zero gives convergence to zero. At nonzero points, original qParameter analyticity gives continuity. Hence continuity holds on each entire actual selected disc, not only its germ.

obligations.name: Global function and exact overlap
obligations.required_input: Identity of global function and exact original overlap.
obligations.constructed_input: Original parameter on original summand; exact sphereChart on every disc.
obligations.justification: filledParameter uses the unique original preimage for points in the original quotient image and the two stated values otherwise. Original embedding injectivity makes the chosen preimage harmless. Original_ne_cusp and cusp injectivity establish its exact cusp values. On every nonzero disc point, original_oldMap identifies it with the actual original quotient point. The already proved qParameter definition then proves equality with sphereChart, with the same original T and same q.

obligations.name: Continuity through the original gluing
obligations.required_input: Continuity for the actual gluing quotient topology.
obligations.constructed_input: Continuous open surjective sum map and all-index disc pullback continuity.
obligations.justification: The sum of the original embedding and the actual discs embedding is continuous, open and jointly surjective, hence a quotient map. The global function's pullback is continuous on its original summand by the original quotientParameter theorem and on its disc summand by the full sphereChart theorem, including every sigma index. The quotient-map continuity criterion therefore supplies continuity of the same constructed filledParameter on the actual gluing topology.

obligations.name: Bijectivity and exceptional cases
obligations.required_input: Injectivity and surjectivity including both boundary cases.
obligations.constructed_input: Original global bijection, nonzero finite original values and distinct exhaustive cusp values.
obligations.justification: Original-to-original injectivity uses the original global fullParameter injectivity. Original images cannot equal infinity and cannot equal zero because T is nonzero. Boundary values are distinct and the two original ends exhaust all added points. Surjectivity covers infinity, zero, and every nonzero complex target separately, using original fullParameter surjectivity for the last case. No generic-fiber count or proper-surjectivity-only argument substitutes for injectivity.

obligations.name: Homeomorphism and identities
obligations.required_input: Actual compactness and independent target Hausdorffness.
obligations.constructed_input: Continuous bijection is closed; same forward parameter gives exact compact homeomorphism.
obligations.justification: Compactness is the previously proved actual filled compactness. The independent standard sphere is Hausdorff. The exact continuous bijection is therefore closed and gives the stated homeomorphism. Its forward function is definitionally filledParameter, and the original restriction and both named cusp values are explicit theorems. No quotient analytic atlas or global inverse holomorphicity is inferred from this topological homeomorphism alone.

obligations.name: Verification and historical scope
obligations.required_input: Exact final source replay and private-inclusive recursive audit.
obligations.constructed_input: Twenty-six freshly replayed modules, twenty-three unchanged predecessors, no analytic-atlas or PEL inference.
obligations.justification: All twenty-six source modules are freshly checked serially with Lean 4.35.0 and kernel checking enabled; recursive axiom collection includes private declarations and permits only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. All twenty-three predecessor sources remain byte-identical, with exact baseline pins and producer contracts bound by the receipt. Distinct review is required. This is the actual compact topological comparison; full complex-atlas compatibility, arithmetic analytification, PEL realization and FiveContact49Height/sourceArithmetic remain excluded.
